case: Cloudflare July2,2019 deployment and incident response
unit: A routine deployment followed by an exceptional incident; not a typical-day sample or AI intervention
evidence_type: Two same-author company accounts, not independent replication

records.source_observation: Functional checks passed; excessive CPU use was not tested.
records.limit: Does not establish that a stronger test would prevent every failure.

records.source_observation: Control-panel access failed; the team used a bypass.
records.limit: Technical access is not the same variable as formal authority. Exclusive approval rights are unknown.

records.source_observation: Reported proposal, execution, traffic recovery and WAF re-enablement are separate events.
records.limit: Minute-resolution self-report; no independent logs or latency attribution.

records.source_observation: Other protections continued while WAF functionality was restored.
records.limit: Recovery has a scope; actual security losses and customer welfare were not measured here.

records.source_observation: WAF releases halted; CPU protection marked done; staged rollout remained an action.
records.limit: Status is as reported July12; no later completion or recurrence audit.

candidate_observation_fields.question: What was proposed, decided, executed or reversed?
What time, timezone, precision and source version supports this stage?
candidate_observation_fields.avoid: Combining a decision timestamp and a recovery timestamp

candidate_observation_fields.question: Who may authorize this action, and can someone actually use the required tool?
candidate_observation_fields.avoid: Inferring permission from access, title or presence

candidate_observation_fields.question: Which service, people, function or goal recovered, and which remained unmet?
candidate_observation_fields.avoid: Treating one operational proxy as all-purpose success

candidate_observation_fields.question: Who bears the interim cost, and what later evidence confirms a planned change?
candidate_observation_fields.avoid: Equating an announced fix with verified lasting improvement

interpretation: These are candidate recording distinctions for researcher review, not a new adopted instrument. Rollback may be a deliberate action without settling the value of its tradeoff.

claim_boundaries.ordinary_routine_countercase: not established: this is an exceptional incident

relationship_to_prior_work: November9 separated non-adoption from missing receipt; this unit separates execution from multiple outcome scopes. The evidence-access pilot remains decisions under a supplied rule.
